column1: # Game profile of Metroid Prime 4: Beyond (Switch, 1.1.0 = v131072). Plays on the Mac (boot, the title, the menus, a new game's opening and the first area of Tanamaar)
# Retro Studios' engine (little-endian RFRM forms as in Metroid Prime Remastered: MaterialArchive.arc and .pak archives) on SDK 19.3.15, NVN; subsdk0 is the SDK's movie library.
# Its shaders are SNVN program records, zstd streams here, in MaterialArchive.arc and in the packs' MTRL resources (shader_split.py rfrm_shaders / snvn_records).
# Every value below is the provisional profile's (profile_guess.py); the bring-up changed none, added dual_want.tsv and needed no host change (README.md)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# no system resource: the game raises SetMemoryHeapSize step by step (2.00, 3.00, 3.12 GB) and settles on 3.16 GB in the 4 GB layout's 3.25 GB heap region, as Metroid Prime
# Remastered does; about 4.0 GB resident and 1.9 GB of Metal allocations in the first area on the Mac
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# 259,989 shaders (129,992 vertex, 129,972 pixel, 19 geometry, 6 compute): MaterialArchive.arc and the MTRL resources of the world, preload, UI and patch packs;
